What a colorful group! 🌈🚴‍♀️

One of our favorite things about the Women’s Shootout is the incredible women we get to ride alongside every Saturday!

Women of all ages, backgrounds, and cycling experiences come together to challenge themselves, push each other, and share a love of riding.

There’s something pretty inspiring about being surrounded by so many strong women and having a whole lot of fun along the way! 💪🧡

Want to join us? Next Saturday, we’ll be starting from University & Euclid, rolling out just after the “Old Man” group of the main Shootout!

Check out our Strava (link in bio) for ride details!

Who are we? 🚴‍♀️

We’re the Women’s Shootout (WSO), a women-only road cycling group founded by legendary triathlete Leanda Cave @leandacave and Pam Alexander!

📍 Based in Tucson, Arizona, we ride the world-famous Shootout route every Saturday. We’re a separate group from the co-ed Shootout rides and, while we ride with their blessing, we’re not affiliated with Fairwheel Bikes.

New Instagram, same great rides! 🎉

Follow along for ride announcements, photos, and all things WSO!

🧡 Want to ride with us? The best place to find our upcoming rides and event details is on Strava (link in bio)!
